_comment: The Adventurer's Guild interior. FIXTURE-FIRST (near_guild -- the interior is the subject, not the street route): starts at (27,3) on the street, facing guild_door. Proves the door round-trip (street -> guild -> street, landing on sane open cells both ways), the desk+Selys interaction (pool-line absorb + her real graph, incl. the new desk-context node), the board and notice-wall dressed props, and walk-on pool lines (Renn, Ilvo, Yelra) -- the full DP1 surface. Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: Chronology: transition() fires map_changed synchronously, world.gd's handler rebuilds the field (mood/map/entities/lights/ambience) BEFORE control returns to wi_game.gd's interact() to record on_enter_accomplishment -- visited_guild is asserted AFTER the render events, matching the real event order.

Up the x=8 column, sidestepping right around (8,4) -- playtest hotfix #5 made the rug there BLOCK (its real footprint occluded the PC walking through it) -- then back onto the desk gap column: up 5 to (8,5), right 1 to (9,5), up 2 to (9,3), left 1 to (8,3), then a blocked bump up against Selys herself (8,2) to set facing up (the SAME trailing-bump idiom door_awakening/etc. use).
SOCIAL S4 idiom: first talk to Selys this waking plays her rotating pool line; a second interact opens the real graph.

Fresh state: only 'Just looking around.' (idx0) and the new 'How does the board work?' (idx1) are visible -- has_package/lyonette_tip/package_delivered/errand_decided/chatted_with_selys:2 are all unmet.
